research_question: Can bounded-history KV eviction delay or miss a streaming safety guard's first unsafe-segment detection while preserving benign specificity?
scope: Source AST, configuration, released labels and length/onset feasibility only. No upstream execution, model weights or inference.

network.transport: GitHub blob API; hf-mirror public pinned resolve because server direct HF is unreachable
network.authenticity_check: HF model and dataset revisions/blob IDs corroborated from official HF API on local Windows; every downloaded non-LFS file checked by Git blob SHA1 and SHA256

gates: All source/data hashes and annotation boundaries must be valid before any task registration.
Verify the exact model is all Full Attention and its custom forward supports correct cached classification.
Do not treat all-unsafe localization splits as a false-positive benchmark.
Do not invent early-token gold labels from a later unsafe sentence or Full-model predictions.
Need enough naturally late onsets and an independent benign cohort; do not add filler to force memory pressure.
Overlap with TRACE, Defensive M2S, streaming guard research, and generic KV safety must remain explicit.
